findings.title: LoadBalancer Service has no external address
findings.cause: LoadBalancer Service web has had no external address for 4m0s: nothing in the cluster provisions load balancers (a cloud controller manager, MetalLB, cloud-provider-kind), or the one there ignores this Service

evidence.what: Service web has type LoadBalancer and no external address after 4m0s
evidence.command: kubectl get service web -n kd-loadbalancer-pending -o jsonpath='{.spec.type}{" "}{.status.loadBalancer}'

findings.fix: Install a load balancer implementation for this cluster, or expose the Service another way (an Ingress or Gateway, or type NodePort).
